ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based screening of all proposed directors, shareholders, authorized representatives, beneficial owners, and commercial counterparties against: UK OFSI Consolidated List, UN Consolidated Sanctions List, Cayman Islands Sanctions List, EU Consolidated Sanctions List, OFAC SDN List, UK AML/CFT PEP registers, and industry adverse-media databases. Enhanced due diligence applies to politically exposed persons (PEPs) and persons connected to high-risk jurisdictions. Screening must be completed before incorporation approval and refreshed at filing of annual returns and beneficial ownership confirmations.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Cayman Islands General Registry – Companies Online Registration Portal (via CIRis / Companies Register electronic filing system)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be in English or any language using the Latin script without diacritical marks; non-Latin script names must be transliterated into English on the certificate of incorporation; names must end with the designating expression 'Limited' or the approved abbreviation 'Ltd.'; names must not be misleadingly similar to an existing company, partnership, foundation, or foreign company registered in the Cayman Islands; proposed names are examined for phonetic and visual similarity; certain names require prior regulatory consent or a license from the Cayman Islands Monetary Authority (CIMA) for regulated activities.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection or objection by the Registrar, the applicant or its licensed corporate service provider may file a written appeal to the Registrar of Companies within 14 days of the refusal, stating grounds of distinctiveness and submitting any required regulatory consents or letters of no objection. If the Registrar denies the appeal, the applicant may submit a new name application, or issue a further administrative appeal to the Cayman Islands General Registry Directorate. If the name rejection is based on conflict with existing registered rights, the applicant may obtain a written consent from the holder of the existing name. Judicial review of a final administrative refusal may be sought before the Grand Court of the Cayman Islands within 21 days of the final decision. The name reservation may be renewed upon payment of applicable fees and re-filing, subject to availability.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office is not permitted as a registered office; a physical registered office in the Cayman Islands is mandatory and must be maintained at a licensed corporate service provider's address. Back-office functions, including digital publishing operations for PC and console storefronts, may be performed remotely from outside the Cayman Islands, but the registered office must remain a physical address where legal process and official communications can be served during business hours.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified risk of unannounced physical on-site inspections: 12%–20% for a non-resident exempted company with no local operating presence and low-risk AML classification; 25%–35% if the company holds a gaming, IP, or digital publishing royalty stream; 10%–15% if the registered office provider itself is subject to scheduled CIMA compliance inspections. The Cayman Islands Monetary Authority and the Tax Information Authority may carry out targeted inspections where economic substance or beneficial ownership compliance is under review.

stage_1.additional_context_note: The composite key indicates a UK parent jurisdiction relationship (GB) and a Cayman Exempted Company (KY_EXEMPTED_CO) engaged in ISIC 5820 software publishing of PC and console video games distributed through Valve Steam and PlayStation Store. Pre-incorporation due diligence covers the Cayman Islands registry obligations, UK sanctions alignment (OFSI), Steam/PlayStation contractual counterparty vetting, and digital storefront payout compliance.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Act (2023 Revision) of the Cayman Islands, ss. 4, 9, 14 and Part II; UK Companies Act 2006 does not govern the formation of this British Overseas Territory entity.

incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital and no escrow-account requirement; the exempted company may be registered with nominal or unissued capital and must maintain a registered office, at least one member, and at least one director.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Cayman company name clearance and reservation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies, General Registry (online e-Services portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation request through the General Registry's online portal or via a licensed corporate service provider. Verify that the proposed name is not identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered name and that it ends with 'Limited', 'Corporation', 'Incorporated' or the appropriate designated suffix for an exempted company. Pay name-reservation fee and retain the reservation reference.
required_dossiers: Certificate of good standing of the corporate services provider (if applicable)
Proof of payment of name-reservation fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected as undesirable or conflicting, file a written objection with alternative names; refiling within 5 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and execution of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed registered agent, Cayman Islands; notarization by Cayman notary public if required
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the exempted company's Memorandum and Articles of Association using the statutory forms. Confirm subscriber details, authorized share capital, objects and exempted-company declarations. Have subscribers execute the M&A before a witness and, if required by the agent or bank, before a notary public. Obtain a signed consent from the proposed registered office provider.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If documents are found deficient, revise execution pages and refile; no additional registry fee if made before submission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of incorporation application to General Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the executed M&A, consent of registered office, name reservation reference and any required statutory declarations with the Registrar. Pay the official government incorporation fee. The filing can be submitted electronically by the licensed corporate service provider on behalf of the company.
required_dossiers: Power of attorney in favour of the corporate service provider
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a query, respond via the corporate service provider within 5 business days with corrected or supplementary documents; cure the specific noted defect and resubmit the same application without a new fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Receipt of Certificate of Incorporation and tax undertaking
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation. If desired, apply for a tax exemption undertaking under section 6 of the Cayman Islands Tax Concessions Act, which may confer an undertaking of tax exemption for up to 20 years for an exempted company. Verify legal details, date and unique entity number.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate contains a typographical error or incorrect capitalization, request administrative rectification through the Registrar with a covering letter and supporting M&A pages.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First board meeting and corporate governance organization
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors of the company; independent legal counsel
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting (in person, by telephone, or by unanimous written resolution). Adopt the first board resolution to allot subscriber shares, fix the registered office address, appoint the first directors and secretary, approve the corporate seal and electronic signature policy, and authorize opening of bank accounts and execution of banking mandates.
required_dossiers: Draft minutes of the first board meeting
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the board resolution is challenged, ratify it with a supplemental written resolution and retroactive board minutes within 14 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-incorporation regulatory filings and compliance onboarding
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: General Registry; Cayman Islands Monetary Authority (CIMA) if AML or economic substance filing applies; Beneficial Ownership Transparency unit
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File initial beneficial ownership particulars within the statutory period and submit the economic substance notification for exempted companies, if applicable. If the company will have banking relationships with EMI or PSP providers, prepare a CIMA-compliant AML file with a risk assessment and ensure the company appoints a Money Laundering Reporting Officer. Maintain the registered agent and statutory records at the registered office.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Late-filing penalties can be appealed to the Registrar on grounds of reasonable cause; false declarations should be corrected by voluntary disclosure within 14 days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not required for digital publishing; for any future physical presence, Cayman Islands Trade and Business Licensing Board, Department of Commerce and Investment
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Trade and Business Licence (only if the exempted company carries on business within the Cayman Islands; not triggered by Steam or PlayStation store publishing)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environment, Cayman Islands Government
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt / not a prescribed activity for pure software publishing; no EIA filing required
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No site-specific discharge or VOC thresholds apply because no manufacturing, warehousing or physical effluent generation occurs; compliance with the National Conservation Act would only be assessed if physical premises are later established

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: No fire-safety or structural-load clearance for a virtual registered office; if physical offices are later occupied, an occupancy permit from the Central Planning Authority and fire-safety certification from the Cayman Islands Fire and Rescue Service would be required.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: HM Revenue & Customs (HMRC) — GOV.UK tax registration portal (https://www.gov.uk/topic/business-tax)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A non-UK established Cayman exempted company making taxable supplies of digital services in the UK must register for VAT directly with HMRC under the Non-Established Taxable Person (NETP) procedure using the online VAT registration service. The company must submit its Cayman certificate of incorporation, registered office/agent details, proof of economic activity, and bank account details. For UK corporation tax, a non-resident company must register with HMRC within three months of commencing a UK permanent establishment and file company tax return CT600; if no UK PE exists, no UK corporation tax registration is mandatory, but UK-source income may still trigger registration obligations. HMRC uses the 10-digit Unique Taxpayer Reference (UTR) for corporation tax and a 9-digit VAT registration number (VRN) for VAT; no separate entity classification ID is issued.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: The UK does not operate a US-style check-the-box election; entity classification follows the local legal form. A non-resident Cayman exempted company is treated as an entity-level taxpayer only where it carries on a trade through a UK permanent establishment. Available statutory elections include (i) VAT grouping election under VATA 1994 s.43A, (ii) option to tax land and buildings under VATA 1994 Sch.10, and (iii) election for non-resident companies to self-assess UK corporation tax on UK-source income. Hybrid mismatch elections under TIOPA 2010 Part 6DA are required to neutralise any hybrid mismatch outcomes, but no elective entity-classification election exists in the UK.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Value Added Tax) under the United Kingdom Value Added Tax Act 1994
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Overseas-established suppliers: no registration threshold — VAT registration is compulsory from the first taxable supply in the UK, including electronically supplied digital games to UK consumers. UK-established suppliers: £90,000 (current UK VAT registration threshold, in force from 1 April 2024).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: The UK has no mandatory real-time fiscal clearance e-invoicing system. HMRC's Making Tax Digital (MTD) for VAT requires VAT-registered businesses to maintain digital records and submit VAT returns via MTD-compatible software using HMRC's API. Invoices must comply with VATA 1994 s.16 (content of VAT invoices), but no government digital stamping or pre-clearance validation of individual invoices is required.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: For physical exports of goods, zero-rating applies under VATA 1994 s.30 and SI 1995/2518 reg.129 where the supplier holds valid evidence of export and the goods physically leave the UK within statutory time limits. For digital publishing services (PC/console games sold via Steam or PlayStation Store), zero-rating as export is not applicable; instead, place-of-supply rules determine UK VAT treatment: B2B supplies to non-UK business customers are outside the scope of UK VAT (reverse charge), and B2C supplies to non-UK consumers are outside the scope if the consumer resides abroad. To substantiate the non-UK status of a recipient, two pieces of non-conflicting evidence of the customer's country of residence/business establishment are required (e.g., IP address verification, billing address, bank details, customer self-certification).
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (SAD C88 / UK CDS)
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent or unsupported export zero-rating claims trigger HMRC assessments, interest under VATA 1994 s.74, and penalties under Finance Act 2007 Sch.24 (up to 30% of potential lost revenue for uncareful inaccuracies; up to 70% for deliberate errors; up to 100% for deliberate and concealed errors). Criminal prosecution is available under VATA 1994 s.72 and CEMA 1979 ss.167-170, with penalties of up to 7 years' imprisonment and unlimited fines. Where export evidence fails, output tax is clawed back retrospectively from the accounting period of supply, and the entity may lose concessional nil-POAL treatment and Customs Comprehensive Guarantee eligibility.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Bank of England (UK monetary authority) acting under residual exchange-control competence delegated by HM Treasury; Cayman Islands Monetary Authority (CIMA) administers the Cayman Islands Dollar Currency Board (CI$1 pegged at US$1.20).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full unrestricted convertibility on both capital and current accounts in the UK and Cayman Islands. The UK repealed the Exchange Control Act 1947 in 1979, eliminating all FX licensing and profit-remittance authorisation. The Cayman Entities Law and the Cayman Islands Monetary Authority Law impose no exchange controls. Consequently, Valve/Steam and Sony PlayStation Store royalties received in USD, EUR or GBP may be held and converted freely; no Board of Trade approval, no prior-declaration regime, and no withholding on dividend or royalty flows at the UK corporate banking layer.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None applicable. Neither the UK nor the Cayman Islands imposes export-proceeds surrender rules, mandatory conversion ratios, or statutory repatriation timelines. USD and EUR gaming-platform remittances may remain in original currency indefinitely. Residual reporting is limited to standard SWIFT/OFSI sanctions screening and Bank of England BOP statistical sampling; no Form A/B/C exchange-control filings exist post-1979.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow and Multi-Currency Operational Account (GBP/USD/EUR)
Multi-Currency Operational Account with Global Transaction Banking portal
USD-Led Operational Account with Correspondent Clearing

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: High feasibility for parallel payment routing, Medium as a sole treasury anchor. FCA-authorised e-money institutions (Wise, Revolut Business, Airwallex, Currenxie, Payoneer) permit rapid onboarding, multi-currency IBANs, and direct Steam/Valve payout ingestion; Payoneer is especially relevant as an integrated settlement rail for Steam publisher balances. Legal constraints: EMIs under the E-Money Regulations 2011 cannot provide overdraft credit or loans; client funds must be safeguarded in segregated accounts with 4% tiering reporting to the FCA; FSCS deposit protection does not apply to e-money balances.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote onboarding is legally permissible under the Money Laundering Regulations 2017 (MLR 2017) using electronic ID&V; no statutory rule requires a physical UK visit. In practice, Cayman offshore exempted companies trigger enhanced due diligence, and HSBC UK or Barclays will mandate either (i) a video interview via Microsoft Teams/Zoom with all directors and UBOs, or (ii) a single-day London branch interview when monthly account turnover exceeds GBP 100,000. Appointment of a UK-registered corporate service provider as company secretary or an independent UK-based non-executive director materially accelerates the approval timeline.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cayman offshore incorporation flagged under JMLSG §7.24 high-risk 'tax haven' typology
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Cayman Certificate of Incorporation; Certificate of Good Standing dated within 90 days; Register of Directors, Officers and Shareholders; Memorandum and Articles of Association; Cayman Economic Substance Notification or exemption confirmation under the International Tax Co-operation (Economic Substance) Act; Board resolution confirming UK and Cayman tax non-residency; group structure chart identifying all UBOs with percentage holdings; and independent corporate-tax historical clearances.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-face-to-face director onboarding and beneficial-ownership opacity
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarised or certified passports of all directors and every UBO holding above 10%; independent video-identification certificates from SmartSearch/Onfido; Cayman Register of Beneficial Owners (LOB) filing acknowledgment; source-of-wealth and source-of-funds statements covering the initial capital injection, formation invoices, Steamworks/PS Partner contracts, and founding-shareholder bank statements.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Digital-games royalty volatility and refund/chargeback exposure
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed Valve Corporation Steamworks distribution agreement and Sony Interactive Entertainment PlayStation Partner agreement; revenue-share schedule (typically 70/30); trailing 12-month platform payout statements; refund and chargeback policy with historical chargeback ratio; US IRS Form W-8BEN-E substantiating treaty-reduced US withholding on software royalties.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions and territorial risk embedded in PC/console storefronts, including restricted states
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Written OFAC, UK OFSI and EU sanctions compliance policy; geo-blocking configuration report from Steamworks and PlayStation Store partner portals; negative-media and sanctions-screening output for the legal entity and all UBOs; legal opinion confirming no revenue originates from sanctioned jurisdictions and that settlement routes exclusively via US/EU payment processors.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Shareholder equity contribution routed from a Cayman-domiciled bank (Butterfield Bank (Cayman) Ltd, Cayman National Bank, or HSBC Bank (Cayman) Limited) to the UK operational account via SWIFT MT103 using ISO 20022 purpose code CAPT (capital payment) or GCR (general corporate purpose). The UK imposes no FX declaration threshold; however, transfers above GBP 20,000 will be subject to standard AML/CTF screening, and banks may require the notarised board capital-resolution, capital-contribution computation, and the Cayman registrar's certificate of good standing for source-of-funds verification.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Clearing rails: (1) Steam/Valve royalties credited in USD via SWIFT MT103 from Valve Corporation, Bellevue WA, or via Payoneer settlement batch; (2) Sony PlayStation Store royalties credited via SIE Europe Ltd in GBP/EUR through SEPA Credit Transfer or UK Faster Payments; (3) internal operating disbursements to development studios via Faster Payments (<GBP 1m) or CHAPS same-day settlement for high-value transfers; (4) international vendor payments via SWIFT MT103 with purpose codes ROYL, LICF or SUPP; (5) shareholder dividend distributions from the UK account to the Cayman account via SWIFT MT103. Commercial letters of credit are not applicable because video-game publishing settlements are service-based flows rather than documentary-goods trades.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright FX Forwards (up to 24 months) for USD/GBP and EUR/GBP royalty conversion, executed with an FCA-authorised counterparty or HSBC/Barclays dealing desk
Rolling FX Swap Contracts for staged conversion of Steam revenue balances
Cross-Currency Swaps (fixed-to-fixed USD revenue vs GBP operating liabilities) for multi-year publishing portfolios
Vanilla FX Options and Zero-Cost Collars designated as cash-flow hedges under IFRS 9 for forecast Steam/PlayStation receipts

Non-Deliverable Forwards are NOT permissible or commercially relevant because GBP, USD, and EUR are fully convertible currencies; NDF usage would breach documented treasury policy and introduce non-hedge accounting volatility

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cayman Islands Registrar of Companies (General Registry)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 60 days after each anniversary of the date of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of CI$250 (approx. US$300) per month or part thereof; continued non-filing for more than six months may trigger administrative dissolution/strike-off, with restoration requiring court application and additional reinstatement fees.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Economic Substance Notification (and Economic Substance Return if a relevant activity is carried on)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cayman Islands Tax Information Authority (TIA) via the Department for International Tax Cooperation portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Notification: within 60 days after the financial year-end; Substance Return: within 12 months after the financial year-end (for a 31 December year-end: notification due 1 March, return due 31 December following).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Monetary default penalties accrue from the filing due date; wilful non-compliance may attract penalties up to CI$10,000 and, for individuals, imprisonment of up to two years; repeated default may be referred to the Registrar for administrative strike-off.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory statutory audit for a non-regulated Cayman Exempted Company; an audit is required only if the entity is licensed or registered under a financial services law or an investment fund. A PC/console game publishing entity using Steam/PlayStation payout rails is not subject to a mandatory audit.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No statutory Cayman Islands GAAP is prescribed for exempted companies. IFRS or US GAAP is commonly adopted if financial statements are prepared for commercial, banking, or economic substance support purposes; financial statements are not publicly filed with the Cayman Registrar.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The Cayman Exempted Company must maintain a Beneficial Ownership Register at its registered office. On each anniversary, the registered office agent issues a confirmation round requiring all directors, members, and beneficial owners to reconfirm current details. Any share transfer or change in beneficial ownership must be recorded in the Register of Members and the Beneficial Ownership Register within 15 days of the event. The annual return filed with the Registrar of Companies functions as the annual statutory confirmation event; the registered office must confirm that the statutory registers are complete and accurate before filing.
